verdict.rationale: Outbound webhooks are a fair question for a SaaS code-review platform like Qodo, so the axis applies. However, nothing in the pack documents letting users subscribe to Qodo events (e.g., review completed or finding created) via webhooks. The cited integrations are PR labels, Git-provider-triggered reviews, ticketing links, MCP and CLI, and the OpenAPI probe returned 404 on every candidate path.
